title: TENKi: counting the value of borrowed knowledge to a materials campaign in measurements saved
description: Figure scripts, result files, producing code and inputs for the paper "TENKi: counting the value of borrowed knowledge to a materials campaign in measurements saved" (Machine Learning: Science and Technology (IOP)). Taylor D. Sparks acknowledges support from the Army Research Office Materials Design, under Contract No. W911NF-23-1-0333.
notes: Code (Python, shell and SLURM scripts) is released under the MIT License (LICENSE). Data, result files and figures are released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0.txt). The archived third-party datasets (Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT, SNUMAT, the Zhuo et al. experimental compilation) keep their own terms; their sources are cited in the paper.
